# sandbox

A tiny Go calculator that r-loop's `/test-app` skill runs the driver against. It is a template, not a repo: `make-sandbox.sh` copies it to a scratch directory, runs `git init` and commits, and prints the path. `docs/plan/todo.md` is a three-phase plan with one `## Resolve first` entry blocking Phase 3, `docs/plan/todo-tiny.md` is a one-phase smoke run, and `issues.md` is an issues file with one open bug, one ticked item and one struck item. `issues-relevance.md` exercises triage relevance (ADR-77/88): `#1` claims a bug the code does not have (`not-a-bug`), `#2` asks for something `docs/spec.md` ADR-1 rules out (`not-relevant`), and `#3` is a real overflow whose drafted fix (return `float64`) breaks ADR-1, so the planner should choose another. `.r-loop/config.yaml` picks cheap models and a single review round.
